, 8-K, 12/11/2017First Contract Year (2018/19): $ 200,000 Second Contract Year (2019/20): $ 204,000 Third Contract Year (2020/21): $ 208,080 Fourth Contract Year (2021/22): $ 212,240 Fifth Contract Year (2022/23): $ 216,490 Sponsor shall pay Club the Annual Fee for each Contract Year of this Agreement in six (6) equal installments, each due on or prior to the 1st of each month between June and November of the applicable Contract Year

(b) In addition to the Annual Fees identified in Section 3(a) above, Sponsor shall provide Club with food, beverage and serving products from Sponsor’s Dicks’ Wings restaurant with values equal to the following (each, an “Annual Trade Value”): First Contract Year (2018/19): $ 35,000 Second Contract Year (2019/20): $ 35,700 Third Contract Year (2020/21): $ 36,410 Fourth Contract Year (2021/22): $ 37,140 Fifth Contract Year (2022/23): $ 37,890 As part of the Annual Trade Value, Sponsor shall provide Club with a designated liaison who will coordinate the menu and quantities to be provided by Sponsor

If any portion of the Annual Trade Value is not used in any given Contract Year, such unused amount shall carry forward to the subsequent Contract Year
If any portion of the Annual Trade Value is not used at the end of the Term, Club shall be permitted to use such unused amount within twelve (12) months following expiration of this Agreement
The parties acknowledge that the Annual Trade Value is inclusive of any taxes, surcharges or related fees applicable to the orders placed by Club during the Term

contract_agreement_summary: Agreement between Jacksonville Jaguars, LLC and The ARC Group, Inc.
Sponsor (The ARC Group, Inc.) to provide annual fees to Club (Jacksonville Jaguars, LLC) in installments.
Sponsor to provide food, beverage, and serving products from Sponsor’s Dicks’ Wings restaurant as part of Annual Trade Value.
Agreement may only be amended in writing signed by authorized representatives of both parties.
Agreement can be executed in counterparts, with electronic transmission having the same effect as original.
compliance_and_expectations_summary: Sponsor shall pay Club the Annual Fee for each Contract Year in six equal installments, due on or prior to the 1st of each month between June and November.
Sponsor shall provide Club with food, beverage and serving products from Sponsor’s Dicks’ Wings restaurant with specified Annual Trade Values.
Sponsor shall provide a designated liaison to coordinate the menu and quantities to be provided.
Sponsor shall deliver the food to the Stadium at the time and location specified by Club.
Unused Annual Trade Value carries forward to the subsequent Contract Year; any amount unused at the end of the Term can be used within twelve months following expiration.
Annual Trade Value is inclusive of any taxes, surcharges or related fees applicable to the orders placed by Club during the Term.
